answer.reason: The verses tell of Zadok's carrying back of the ark during Absalom's revolt, his anointing of Solomon, and his appointment in Abiathar's place.

clauses.english: carried the ark of God back to Jerusalem at David's command
clauses.quote: Zadok therefore and Abiathar carried the ark of God again to Jerusalem
took an horn of oil out of the tabernacle, and anointed Solomon

clauses.english: was put by the king in the place of Abiathar as priest
clauses.quote: Zadok the priest did the king put in the room of Abiathar

doubts: Verses naming sons of Zadok (EZK 40:46, 43:19, 44:15, 48:11) and the house of Zadok (2CH 31:10) concern a priestly line, not Zadok's own deeds, so they were left out.
1CH 12:28 (a young man mighty of valour) was left out as a description, not an event.
